capabilities.summary: Round 13 targets one warmed runtime, one in-memory Coordination engine, a closed local Timeline journal, synchronous drain, and public Java 17 API use.
The target profile reuses three unique managed child sessions across five Process Embedded occurrences and exposes five parent initialization-event occurrences.
External provider adapters and provider-backed fresh-process durability are explicitly outside this Playground profile.
Mandate-backed delegated operations are explicitly outside Round 13 and unsupported Mandate-backed entries must still be rejected.

finalizationRequirements: At staging time, rerun the complete published-artifact release gate and verify the clean candidate ancestry and unchanged production-source manifest.
Require passing Java 17 and Java 21 lanes, all four test suites, all six non-performance Round 13 proof rows, and all eight exact-zero structural counters.
Rebuild and verify all four JARs, the reproducible source archive, extracted-source focused tests, and published-artifact smoke.
Require complete POM metadata, staged checksums, signatures, and published-dependency resolution before upload.
Apply the known-performance-limitation policy only to 3.0.0-rc.1; remediate and pass performance gates before any stable release.
limitations: The exact 3.0.0-rc.1 release policy accepts one disclosed Round 13 performance failure for RC evaluation only; it does not classify the latency campaign as passing and cannot authorize a stable release.
The engine remains sequential, single-process, synchronous, and in-memory.

The retained Round 13 campaign failed append p95 (18.680667 ms > 1.000000 ms hard) and coordination-host p95 (872.356126 ms > 250.000000 ms hard); route p95 (0.097583 ms) and total p95 (3,998.664166 ms) passed hard, while all four preferred targets were missed.
